confirmed_decisions.title: Authentication Strategy
confirmed_decisions.decision: Use email/password as the primary authentication mechanism with Argon2id password hashing, JWT access token (15m), refresh token (7d), and single-use verification tokens.
confirmed_decisions.evidence: docs/project-documents/EduSense – Source-of-Truth Summary for AI Agents (English).md (Section 0.1, 4.1)

confirmed_decisions.title: Service Architecture & Boundaries
confirmed_decisions.decision: Service-based architecture with shared PostgreSQL database: API Backend (FastAPI), AI Service (Python), Background Worker (Celery + Redis), Scheduler (Celery Beat), MinIO Object Storage.

confirmed_decisions.title: Database Schema & Vector Search
confirmed_decisions.decision: PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector extension enabled. 38 business and operational tables from EduSense_PostgreSQL_Schema_Revised.sql deployed as Alembic baseline migration 0001_initial_baseline.py.

confirmed_decisions.title: Central AI Adapter Boundary
confirmed_decisions.decision: All Google Gemini calls MUST pass through a single shared Adapter module (providers package). Routers, background workers, and tasks must NEVER import the Gemini SDK directly.

confirmed_decisions.title: Quota Management & Fail-Closed Behavior
confirmed_decisions.decision: Atomic Redis counters for quota reservation prior to LLM call with refund on failure. Fail-closed: if Redis is unreachable, reject the AI request.

confirmed_decisions.title: Object Storage Isolation
confirmed_decisions.decision: MinIO bucket edusense-documents is private. Client never accesses MinIO directly; uploads and downloads handled via API Backend and presigned URLs.

confirmed_decisions.title: Frontend Framework & Typing Standards
confirmed_decisions.decision: Vue 3 Single File Components (<script setup lang='ts'>), Tailwind CSS, TypeScript with strict typing. All new code must be TypeScript; no bulk JS conversion.

confirmed_decisions.title: Social Login (OAuth2) Activation
confirmed_decisions.decision: Approved: Implement Google OAuth2 social login in M1
confirmed_decisions.evidence: Human authorization via workflow approve CLI

unresolved_questions.title: Pro Subscription Pricing, Duration & Billing Rules
unresolved_questions.question: What is the official price (VND) and duration for the Pro plan (e.g. 50,000 VND / 30 days), and should live SePay webhook processing be enabled in development?
unresolved_questions.proposed_default: Mock payment mode in development. Do not activate live payments or charge real accounts until PO approves pricing.

unresolved_questions.title: Cross-User Document Sharing Scope
unresolved_questions.question: Should students be allowed to share documents or question banks publicly with other students in Phase 1?
unresolved_questions.proposed_default: Strict user-scoped isolation (R-06). Documents and vector searches are strictly private to user_id.
unresolved_questions.impact: Keeps RAG queries 100% tenant-isolated without complex access control matrices.

proposed_defaults.title: Document Chunking Strategy
proposed_defaults.proposed_value: Parent chunk 1200-1500 tokens, child chunk 400-500 tokens, overlap 60-75 tokens

proposed_defaults.title: File Upload Caps
proposed_defaults.proposed_value: 20 MB per file, max 100 pages for PDF, max 10 files per upload request

proposed_defaults.title: Default AI Daily Quota Limits
proposed_defaults.proposed_value: Free plan = 10 AI requests/day; Pro plan = 150 requests/day; warning at 80% usage
